prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: old monastery gardens transformed into a hazardous pursuit ground. Scene/backdrop: narrow water channels, tangled roots, clipped hedges, small stone islands, herb plots, weathered cloisters and modest utility sheds. Subject: many small irregular obstacles fragmenting space into winding but passable routes; an old bell pavilion and garden canal crossing as landmark. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: clear readable daylight, controlled contrast. Color palette: moss green, muted herbs and flowers, pale weathered stone, soft water blue, restrained amber. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space. Avoid: pristine palace garden, dense impassable hedge maze, tropical vegetation, crowds.
